searches.query: latest research papers AI ML simplified
searches.answer: The latest research papers in AI and ML include the Idefics2 model from April 2024, which improved OCR capabilities and simplified architecture, and the Phi 3 Vision model from May 2024, a first multimodal model in the Phi family. Other notable papers include SimCLR from February 2020, a simplified framework for contrastive learning, and Granite Code Models and Codestral 22B from May 2024, both designed for code generation tasks. Additionally, Nature Methods introduced AI Bytes to simplify AI concepts for the life sciences community, and Morgan Stanley's research includes a provably convergent Schrödinger bridge model for time series imputation.
